hook: 字尾 -sion：delusion 幻覺、aspersion 誹謗、repercussion 餘波——走廊一喊，回音專門幫你加戲。
script: delusion 妄想。aspersion 潑髒水。repercussion 後果餘波。concession 讓步。remission 緩解。procession 遊行隊伍穿廊而過。

members.senseAnchor: (psychology) an erroneous belief that is held in the face of evidence to the contrary; a mistaken or unfounded opinion or idea
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 幻覺燈: delusion walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「幻覺燈」出場：delusion 一上場梗就黏住——妄想。

members.senseAnchor: a remote or indirect consequence of some action; a movement back from an impact
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 回力球: repercussion walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「回力球」出場：repercussion 一上場梗就黏住——餘波後果。

members.senseAnchor: a contract granting the right to operate a subsidiary business; the act of conceding or yielding
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 讓步牌: concession walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「讓步牌」出場：concession 一上場梗就黏住——讓步。

members.senseAnchor: an abatement in intensity or degree (as in the manifestations of a disease); a payment of money sent to a person in another place
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 減號燈: remission walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「減號燈」出場：remission 一上場梗就黏住——緩解減輕。

related.synonyms: remittal, subsidence, remittance, remitment, remit, absolution

members.senseAnchor: (theology) the origination of the Holy Spirit at Pentecost; the group action of a collection of people or animals or vehicles moving ahead in more or less regular formation
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 遊行隊: procession walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「遊行隊」出場：procession 一上場梗就黏住——行列遊行。

related.synonyms: emanation, rise, progress, progression, advance, advancement

members.senseAnchor: fearful expectation or anticipation; the cognitive condition of someone who understands
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 心驚鈴: apprehension walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「心驚鈴」出場：apprehension 一上場梗就黏住——憂懼。

related.synonyms: apprehensiveness, dread, understanding, discernment, savvy, misgiving

members.senseAnchor: a false or unsupportable quality; the advancing of a claim
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 抬下巴: pretension walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「抬下巴」出場：pretension 一上場梗就黏住——自負。

members.senseAnchor: a stipulated condition; the activity of supplying or providing something
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 條款箱: provision walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「條款箱」出場：provision 一上場梗就黏住——供應條款。

related.synonyms: proviso, supply, supplying, planning, preparation, purvey

members.senseAnchor: the state of the economy declines; a widespread decline in the GDP and employment and trade lasting from six months to a year; a small concavity
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 下滑梯: recession walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「下滑梯」出場：recession 一上場梗就黏住——衰退。

members.speakLineEn: Cue the 割讓書: cession walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「割讓書」出場：cession 一上場梗就黏住——割讓。

members.senseAnchor: (astrology) one of 12 equal areas into which the zodiac is divided; a large and imposing house
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 豪宅門: mansion walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「豪宅門」出場：mansion 一上場梗就黏住——豪宅。

members.speakLineEn: Cue the 遊行: parade walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「遊行」出場：parade 一上場梗就黏住——遊行。
members.vocabNote: 留在幽默庫作構詞／劇本用；暫不列入 GRE 難詞主庫，避免稀釋考點密度。

members.speakLineEn: Cue the 鈴: bell walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「鈴」出場：bell 一上場梗就黏住——鈴。
members.vocabNote: 留在幽默庫作構詞／劇本用；暫不列入 GRE 難詞主庫，避免稀釋考點密度。

members.speakLineEn: Cue the 門: door walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「門」出場：door 一上場梗就黏住——門。
members.vocabNote: 留在幽默庫作構詞／劇本用；暫不列入 GRE 難詞主庫，避免稀釋考點密度。

pitfalls: delusion＝妄想；illusion＝錯覺——近義但層次不同
